## Current PM — 🟢 os-project-manager

- **Holder:** `os-project-manager` · `session_01FEkQ5krBqrrgxCYgjXmfbv` · seated 2026-11-21T15:40Z by **forced takeover** (`project-forms.md` 接管) on the maintainer's word in this account's fleet project, verbatim: 「你现在的座位都下班，然后加载最新的技能，重开 objectstack 全仓座位」 and 「你接手他的工作」 (the seat 4 hand-over of `session_016WV4d1PJ4isQ3eD7Fk1fnF`, written 2026-11-21T13:27Z after the holder's own 「当前任务处理完就下班呢」). Previous holder `os-elon-musk` · `session_016WV4d1PJ4isQ3eD7Fk1fnF`; its old mailbox #35555 is closed. The takeover covers the seat, its leases, its in-flight cards and its PRs; each card carries its own four-piece takeover comment.
- **Intake:** (1) the inherited seat 4 work: every card assigned to this seat at takeover and its PR; (2) beyond that, on the maintainer's word 「除了交接的工作，后续处理全仓非专题的 p1 任务，包括阻塞 p1 的任务」 (superseding the same-minute 「…非专题的 p1 任务」): open `priority:p1` cards, and the cards that block one of them (`Blocked-by:`), anywhere in this repository that are not part of a theme, read as: no `pm:epic`, not a sub-issue of an epic or tracking parent, and not held by another seat. On the maintainer's word 2026-11-21T15:32Z, seat 1 now takes theme (epic) work only and no longer `area:build` / `area:fleet`, and seat 7 (`area:data`) is handing over; so their non-epic p1 cards are in this intake. Seat 7's unfinished work arrives through this seat's mailbox and is followed to merge. On the maintainer's word 2026-11-21T15:34Z 「ai ux 你不要派，避免 和现有座位重复」, no new `area:ai` or `area:ux` card is dispatched here (the inherited `area:ai` PRs still run to merge); so #35907 and #35403 are not taken, and #35315 / #35399 wait behind #35403. No other new p2/p3 claims; p3 rides only on an inherited PR.
  - Excluded: cloud cards (`domain:cloud`), security advisories (`security` seats), untriaged cards, `needs-user-decision` / `pm:retriage` cards, and cards another seat holds (`Claim:`, `Area:` line, lease row or assignee).
- **Concurrency:** at most 10 developments running at once, on the maintainer's word 2026-11-21T15:37Z 「同时开发的并发不超过 10」 (it corrects the same-minute 「并发不超过 15」).
- **Mailbox:** PR #36124 (subscribed). **Patrol:** `trig_013Uom3rDuEEEjwSoNxGyEod` · `13 * * * *` (bound to this session).
- **Posture ledger lives in the project:** the labels, the assignee, the `Claim:` comments carrying `Seat: repo:objectstack#4`, and the `head:claude/` PRs.
